name: mcp-azure-devops
description: Azure DevOps Model Context Protocol Server
long_description:
An advanced Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that connects AI assistants to Azure DevOps (formerly VSTS).

It exposes 23 specialized tools to manage work items (bugs, tasks, user stories), Git repositories, branches, commits, pull requests, PR review comments, pipelines, and search user identities.

Additionally, it contains an offline local database of the Azure DevOps REST API schemas and parameters, enabling the server to suggest the correct endpoints and perform generic REST requests dynamically.

username.title: Username
username.description: Your Azure DevOps username or email

pat.title: Personal Access Token (PAT)
pat.description: Your Azure DevOps Personal Access Token (PAT)

defaultProject.title: Default Project
defaultProject.description: (Optional) The default project to use if not specified in tool calls

tools.name: configure_connection
tools.description: Configures Azure DevOps credentials (Username & PAT) for a specific organization/project URL. Must be called first if not configured.

tools.name: test_connection
tools.description: Verifies connection to Azure DevOps for a configured organization.

tools.name: call_api
tools.description: Executes a generic Azure DevOps REST API call. Supports ALL DevOps endpoints. (Default API Version: 7.1)

tools.name: search_api_docs
tools.description: Searches the local database of Azure DevOps APIs and parameters to find the correct endpoints offline.

tools.name: get_api_info
tools.description: Gets full documentation for a specific Azure DevOps API endpoint. Checks the local database first and falls back to Microsoft specs online.

tools.name: get_work_item
tools.description: Retrieves details for a specific Azure DevOps work item by ID.

tools.name: create_work_item
tools.description: Creates a new work item (Bug, Task, User Story) in Azure DevOps.

tools.name: update_work_item
tools.description: Updates field values on an existing work item.

tools.name: query_work_items
tools.description: Searches work items using Work Item Query Language (WIQL) and returns batch details.

tools.name: add_work_item_comment
tools.description: Adds a new discussion comment to a work item.

tools.name: link_work_item
tools.description: Links two work items together using a relation type (e.g., Parent/Child, Duplicate, Related).

tools.name: list_repositories
tools.description: Lists all Git repositories in the configured project.

tools.name: get_git_file
tools.description: Reads content of a file from an Azure DevOps Git repository.

tools.name: create_git_push
tools.description: Pushes file changes (adds, modifications, deletes) directly to a repository branch.

tools.name: create_pull_request
tools.description: Creates a Pull Request in a Git repository.

tools.name: get_pull_request
tools.description: Gets details and status of a Pull Request.

tools.name: update_pull_request
tools.description: Updates a Pull Request status (active, abandoned, completed).

tools.name: create_pull_request_thread
tools.description: Creates an inline code review comment thread on a file and line number in a PR.

tools.name: list_pull_request_threads
tools.description: Retrieves all threads and comments on a PR.

tools.name: run_pipeline
tools.description: Triggers a run of a pipeline.

tools.name: get_pipeline_run
tools.description: Retrieves status of a pipeline run.

tools.name: get_pipeline_run_logs
tools.description: Retrieves combined log content for a pipeline run.

tools.name: search_identities
tools.description: Searches for users or groups in the organization by name or email.
